blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump on Wednesday said the alliance between Manila and Washington “has never been better,” contrasting it with what he described as a “not very good” relationship under previous administrations. Trump made the remarks during his bilateral meeting with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. at Malacañang Palace. His comments were a thinly veiled reference to the administration of former President Rodrigo Duterte, who expressed anti-American sentiments and at one point moved to abrogate the country’s landmark agreement with its sole treaty ally before reversing course.
